rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a vague impression or an emotion, but use 概念 for an emerging understanding.

example.english: I have a very special feel about this restaurant.
example.traditional: 我對呢間餐廳有種好特別嘅感覺。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 zung2 hou2 dak6 bit6 ge3 gam2 gok3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for thinking, having an impression, or finding that something seems a certain way.

example.english: I feel this movie is pretty good.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 tou3 hei3 gei2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for physically touching something or feeling around for an object by touch.

example.english: I can feel that the table is still wet.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mo2 dou2 zoeng1 toi2 zung6 hai6 sap1 ge3

rows.note: Use this when someone experiences or senses an emotion or other mental state, especially one conveyed by another person or work.

example.english: I can feel your loneliness in your song.
example.traditional: 我喺你首歌入面感受到你嘅孤單。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 nei5 sau2 go1 jap6 min6 gam2 sau6 dou3 nei5 ge3 gu1 daan1

rows.note: Use this for the tactile feel or texture of a material, especially how it feels in the hand.

example.english: This leather has a very soft feel.
example.traditional: 呢塊皮摸落去手感好柔軟。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 pei4 mo1 lok6 heoi3 sau2 gam2 hou2 jau4 jyun5

rows.note: Use this specifically when 'feel for someone' means to sympathize with them or their suffering.

example.english: I really feel for those people who lost their homes.
example.traditional: 我真係好同情嗰啲失去屋企嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung4 cing4 go2 di1 sat1 heoi3 uk1 kei2 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this when getting a feel means gradually gaining a basic understanding or idea of something.

example.english: I’m slowly starting to get a feel for how this game works.
example.traditional: 我慢慢對呢個玩法有啲概念喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maan6 maan6 deoi3 ni1 go3 waan2 faat3 jau5 di1 koi3 nim6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a feel means an intuitive knack or natural aptitude for an activity.

example.english: They have a real feel for soccer.
example.jyutping: keoi5 tek3 bo1 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 tin1 fan6
